claim.scope_statement: Comparative exposition of the OpenAI, Banks, Kerr, Green and Kevin Barreto manuscripts on uniform exclusion of Landau–Siegel zeros. Explains the Wronskian independence argument, weighted support and prime divisibility, and conversion to a real-zero bound. Supplements the existing Math-77-A2 claim summary; no new theorem, full independent proof certification, or catalogue status change is claimed.
